calibration.question: map.terrain: how is “3D” said in Urdu, where no Latin letter is allowed (EN “3D terrain map”, AR «الخريطة التضاريسية 3D»)?
candidates: A «سہ جہتی» — «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا سہ جہتی نقشہ» (stages 1–5).
B «تھری ڈی» — the English letters spelled in Urdu script.
C «تین جہتی» — «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا تین جہتی نقشہ».
calibration.evidence: Stage 4 (s45-web.json, HTTP 200): A Rekhta headword «سَہ جِہَتی» “three dimensional” (the entry carries no part-of-speech label), ur.wikipedia 41 pages, «سہ جہتی نقشہ» 1 (چندریان-2); B 607 pages, film formats and product names, no headword, «تھری ڈی نقشہ» 0; C 37 pages, among them the reference article «نقشہ» («… دو جہتی ہوتے ہیں، تین جہتی …»); D 18, mathematics and physics. Re-counted by the judge 2026-10-16 (s7-web.json, HTTP 200): «تین جہتی» 37 (top titles کرہ ارض · نقشہ · تصویر), «سہ جہتی» 41, «تین جہتی نقشہ» 0. Rekhta: no entry page for «تین جہتی» under the three slugs tried (meaning-of-tiin-jihatii, meaning-of-teen-jihatii, meaning-of-tiin-jahatii — all three redirect to the home page, proof re-fetch 2026-10-16, p1-rekhta.txt); the entry «سہ جہتی» answers (meaning-of-sah-jihatii, HTTP 200, “three dimensional”, no part of speech on its card — p1-sah.txt). Blind reader on-05 item 5 (moderate): «سہ جہتی» and «نشیب و فراز» “bookish and over-Persianized”. Blind reader on-r1 item 14 (moderate), on the C wording: “bookish, long label”, understood after a second read; he does not single out «تین جہتی», his own form writes the Latin «3D»; no count reading of «تین» after the chip count «(3)» reported.
calibration.stage4_recommendation: A stays; C is the fallback if the blind reader finds «سہ» bookish or unknown.
calibration.ruling_or_recommendation: C: «تین جہتی» — map.terrain «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا تین جہتی نقشہ». The on-05 reader’s charge is the condition stage 4 set for the fallback, and between two native words a reader’s stumble is evidence (the restriction of P16 is on loans). C is the plainer of the two, the wording the reference article on maps uses, and needs no Latin letter and no figure. B refused: P16-test (2) is met, but (1) is not (the reference names 3D maps natively, A and C) and (3) is not (no headword); a stumble alone never admits a loan. A withdrawn from this string; it stays a correct headword and is recorded in C’s entry for search. D not taken (technical). Cost: «تین جہتی» has no entry page of its own (both parts are common words; the compound is attested in use). ROUND 2: proofed on r1 (must-fix 0) and read blind on r1; C kept — the second reader’s charge falls on the label’s length and on «نشیب و فراز» (N333), not on «تین جہتی», and «سہ جہتی» cannot return (it was contested by the first reader).
calibration.binds: map.terrain; every later interface string that says “3D” (tmap.* when the terrain page is translated).

calibration.question: map.lead.a: the action clause — “tap any place … to open its card” (AR «واضغط أي معلم … لفتح بطاقته»).

calibration.question: map.terrain: the length and wording of the terrain link label.
candidates: A «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا … نقشہ» — six words (stages 1–5).
B «نشیب و فراز کا … نقشہ» — without «زمین کے».
calibration.evidence: Stage 4: the link sits in the wrapping tool row (.map-tools, flex-wrap), not among the chips; Rekhta «نَشِیب و فَراز» Persian, Noun, Masculine, “descent and ascent … unevenness … vicissitudes”; ur.wikipedia 63 pages (re-counted 2026-10-16, s7-web.json; the article «نشیب و فراز» first), mostly figurative; «زمین کے نشیب و فراز» 0 (a transparent phrase); «طبعی نقشہ» 0. Blind reader on-05 item 5: «نشیب و فراز» bookish; he understood a terrain map after a second read; his alternative (“showing mountains and sand dunes”) adds what neither source says. Blind reader on-r1 item 14 (moderate): the label “bookish, long”, understood as a 3D terrain map after a second read; unsure whether the link opens another page or changes this map; his form «زمین کی اونچائی نیچائی کا 3D نقشہ» (Latin «3D»; «اونچائی نیچائی» not in the line’s evidence).
calibration.stage4_recommendation: A; B if the row is judged too long.
calibration.ruling_or_recommendation: A: «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا تین جہتی نقشہ» (with N331 C). Both source words kept; «زمین کے» fixes the literal sense of «نشیب و فراز» (relief, not the ups and downs of fortune). B drops that anchor; C coins an unattested term and widens “terrain” to “physical”. ROUND 2: kept against two readers’ moderate charge of register (on-05 5, on-r1 14): both read the label correctly; the sourced entry is not replaced on taste alone, and no plainer attested native phrase for “terrain” is in the evidence. Cost charged under nativeness (three points) and fit (one). Option for the owner and for the batch that translates the terrain page (tmap.*), one line: a plainer native phrase («زمین کی اونچ نیچ», or the reader’s «اونچائی نیچائی»), each needing its own evidence through the line.
calibration.guard: Stage checker: the string «سہ جہتی طبعی نقشہ» does not occur. For the proofreader, not machine-read: the terrain link label keeps «زمین کے» before «نشیب و فراز», and is not «تین جہتی طبعی نقشہ» either (C with N331’s word; never a wording of the chain, so not in the machine clause). The machine clause bans exactly candidate C’s full label as the chain proposed it, never «طبعی نقشہ» elsewhere.

تین جہتی.note: STAGE 7 (b21-ui, round 1): N331 C ruled, replacing the stage-1/4 proposal «سہ جہتی» in map.terrain after the on-05 blind reader called it bookish (item 5). Verified on HTTP-200 usage attestation (ur.wikipedia, the reference article on maps); no dictionary entry page of its own: nothing more is claimed. Used as an invariable adjective before «نقشہ» (the judge’s grammatical reading, not a dictionary label); the gender field is formal, «مذکر» being the gender of the noun it qualifies in its one use. Native compound, not a loan (P16 not engaged). «سہ جہتی» (Rekhta headword) is a correct synonym, recorded here for search and not used on /ur/ today; «تھری ڈی» refused (P16-test (1), (3)); the Latin «3D» is never written. Used in map.terrain only: «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا تین جہتی نقشہ». ‖ ROUND 2: record corrected (the part of speech round 1 attributed to Rekhta struck; three slugs, not two); the on-r1 reader did not single the word out (item 14).

نشیب و فراز.note: STAGE 1 (b21-ui) proposal, STAGE 4 verified: gender read on the entry page (Noun, Masculine) and exercised in the text («زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا»).
